subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
6.  
Rinki Ltd. has two divisions, A and B. Target profit of A is ` 100 lakh. A 
has capacity to produce 20,000 units of product P but only 15,000 units 
are produced and sold in the market at ` 3,000 per unit. B received an 
order for which P would be required as input. B approaches A for 
purchase of 5000 units of P. What price should A charge from B per unit 
of P so as to meet its target profit? (Other details of A are: Fixed cost is  
` 90 lakh; Variable cost per unit of P is ` 2,000)  
(A)  ` 3,000  
(B)  
` 2,800  
(C)  ` 2,500  
(D)  ` 2,000
suggested_answer: (B) ` 2,800 Revenue = 15,000 × 3,000 = 450,00,000 (` 450 lakh) Variable cost = 15,000 × 2,000 = 300,00,000 (` 300 lakh) Contribution = 450 - 300 = ` 150 lakh Profit = Contribution - Fixed cost = 150 - 90 = ` 60 lakh Target Profit = 100 - 60 = ` 40 lakh Required contribution per unit = 40,00,000/5,000 = ` 800/unit Transfer price = Variable cost + 800 = 2,000 + 800 = ` 2,800/unit
